draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and clear, indicating a specific body part
notes: 팔 refers to the entire limb from the shoulder down to the hand, including the elbow and forearm. Note that it is distinct from 손 (hand), which is specifically the part from the wrist downward.
This word is a homonym. It also means the number eight (8). Context will always make it clear whether you are talking about anatomy or counting.
